Metadata.title: IBNI — Algeria's Education Platform
Metadata.description: An Algerian education platform connecting parents, students, teachers, and institutions.

Hero.title: Crafting the Leaders of Tomorrow. Today.
Hero.subtitle: A complete education platform connecting parents, students, teachers, and institutions across Algeria.
Hero.searchPlaceholder: Search for schools, teachers, or resources...

Audience.title: Built for Everyone in Education
Audience.subtitle: One platform, four journeys — each with the tools it actually needs.

parents.title: Parents
parents.description: Track each child's attendance, behavior, academic performance, and school communications in one view.

students.title: Students
students.description: See assignments, deadlines, achievements, and recommended next steps in one dashboard.

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.description: Manage classes, record attendance, grades and behavior, and publish a CV-style profile.

institutions.title: Institutions
institutions.description: Publish a verified profile and make your school discoverable by location, type, specialization, and language.

HowItWorks.title: How IBNI Works
HowItWorks.subtitle: Three steps that turn a scattered school week into one connected platform.

track.title: Track Progress
track.description: Follow attendance, grades, and behavior as they happen, so nothing important waits for a term report.

communicate.title: Direct Communication
communicate.description: Message teachers and institutions in one place, with announcements and alerts that reach the right people.

store.title: Educational Store
store.description: Find tutoring, courses, books, and school supplies from verified teachers and institutions.

Cta.title: Ready to transform your school experience?
Cta.subtitle: Join thousands of parents, students, teachers, and institutions already building a better school day on IBNI.

Footer.description: Algeria's education platform, connecting parents, students, teachers, and institutions in one place.
